password.label: Password
password.description: Leave blank to keep the same password

currentPassword.label: Current password
currentPassword.required: Enter your current password to change it

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.summary: You are currently logged into {{amount}} other devices

logoutAll.title: Log out of all devices?
logoutAll.message: Are you sure you want to log out of all devices? This will log you out of all devices except the current one.

logoutDevice.title: Log out of device?
logoutDevice.message: Are you sure you want to log out of this device?

dashboard.title: Dashboard Settings
dashboard.description: These settings are saved automatically in your browser.

disableMediaPreview.label: Disable Media Preview
disableMediaPreview.description: Disable previews of files in the dashboard. This may help to save data and speed up the dashboard if you have a lot of media files, but it will also disable the file viewer and show a generic file icon instead of a preview for supported files.

mediaAutoMuted.label: Mute video and audio previews
mediaAutoMuted.description: When enabled, video and audio in the file viewer autoplay muted. Turning this off tries to play sound immediately. Browsers may block unmuted autoplay until you interact with the page.

warnDeletion.label: Warn on deletion
warnDeletion.description: Show a warning when deleting stuff. When this is disabled, files, urls, etc will be deleted with no prior warning! Folders, users, and bulk-transactions are exempt from this rule and will always warn you before deleting anything.

fileNavButtons.label: File navigation buttons
fileNavButtons.description: Show previous/next on the right and left of the file viewer to easily navigate between files.

homeShowRecents.label: Show recents
homeShowRecents.description: Show recent uploads and logins on the home page.

homeShowActivity.label: Show activity
homeShowActivity.description: Show your recent activity as a graph on the home page.

homeShowTypes.label: Show file types
homeShowTypes.description: Show the file types table on the home page.

fileViewer.label: File viewer
fileViewer.description: Choose which file viewer opens when you click a file.

domain.label: Default Domain
domain.description: Set the default domain used for copied links anywhere in the dashboard. Leave blank or select "Default domain" to use the current domain that serves the dashboard.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: The theme to use for the dashboard. This is only a visual change on your browser and does not change the theme for other users.

themeDark.label: Dark Theme
themeDark.description: The theme to use for the dashboard when your system is in dark mode.

themeLight.label: Light Theme
themeLight.description: The theme to use for the dashboard when your system is in light mode.

disableTextFiles.label: Disable text files
disableTextFiles.description: Disable viewing text files through view-routes. This has no effect on other file types and will work even if view-routes are disabled.

enabled.label: Enable View Routes
enabled.description: Enable viewing files through customizable view-routes

showMimetype.label: Show mimetype
showMimetype.description: Show the mimetype of the file in the view-route

showTags.label: Show tags
showTags.description: Show the file's tags in the view-route

showFolder.label: Show folder
showFolder.description: Show the name/link of the folder if possible in the view-route

content.label: View Content
content.description: Change the content within view-routes. Most HTML is valid, while the use of JavaScript is unavailable.

align.label: View Content Alignment
align.description: Change the alignment of the content within view-routes

embed.label: Enable Embed
embed.description: Enable the following embed properties. These properties take advantage of OpenGraph tags. View routes will need to be enabled for this to work.

embedMediaOnly.label: Media-only link preview
embedMediaOnly.description: When embeds are off, still add OpenGraph image/video tags so Discord and similar apps unfurl the media only (no custom title, description, or site name). The URL you paste stays in the message as plain text.

mfa.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
mfa.description: Setup 2FA or passkeys to add an extra layer of security to your account.

modal.disableInstructions: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app below to confirm disabling 2FA.
modal.step1: Step 1 Open/download an authenticator that supports QR code scanning or manual code entry. Popular options include 2FAs, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, and Apple Passwords.
modal.step2: Step 2 Scan the QR code below with your authenticator app to enable 2FA.
modal.manualEntry: If you can't scan the QR code, you can manually enter the following code into your authenticator app: {{secret}}
modal.step3: Step 3 Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app below to confirm 2FA setup.

enabled.title: 2FA Enabled
enabled.message: You have successfully enabled 2FA on your account.

disabled.title: 2FA Disabled
disabled.message: You have successfully disabled 2FA on your account.

passkeys.legacyWarning: Warning: This passkey was created with an older version of Zipline and WILL NOT work with this version. Please delete and recreate this passkey to ensure compatibility.
passkeys.createError: Error while creating a passkey - try again later
passkeys.createErrorFallback: An error occurred while creating a passkey
passkeys.namePrompt: Assign a name to this passkey so you can remember it later.

remove.message: Your browser and device may still show "{{name}}" as an option to log in. If you want to remove it, you'll have to do so manually through your device's settings.

saved.title: Passkey saved!
saved.message: Your passkey has been saved successfully.

removed.title: Passkey removed!
removed.message: Your passkey has been removed successfully.

exports.title: Export Files
exports.empty: No exports found. Click the button above to start a new export.

new.title: New export?
new.message: Are you sure you want to start a new export? If you have a lot of files, this may take a while.

started.title: Export started
started.message: Export has been started, you can check its status in the table below

generators.title: Generate Uploaders
generators.description: Generate scripts for upload tools. The Flameshot and Shell Script generators are supported on only Linux and macOS.

desc.flameshot: To use this script, you need Flameshot, curl, jq, and xclip (linux only) installed. This script is intended for use on Linux and macOS only (see options below).
desc.ishare: This generator requires <link>ishare</link> to be installed on macOS. This uploader is intended for use on macOS only.
desc.itake: This generator requires <link>iTake</link> to be installed on macOS. This uploader is intended for use on macOS only.
desc.shell: To use this script, you need bash, curl, file, jq, and xclip (linux only) installed. This script is intended for use on Linux and macOS only (see options below).

modal.title: Generate {{name}} Uploader

destinationType.label: Destination Type
destinationType.description: Select which type of destination you want to generate

format.label: Name format
format.description: The file name format to use when uploading files, the "File name" field will override this value.

compression.label: Compression
compression.description: The compression level to use on images (only). Leave blank to disable compression.

maxViews.label: Max Views
maxViews.description: The maximum number of views files/urls can have before they are deleted. Leave blank to allow as many views as you want.

overrideDomain.label: Override Domain
overrideDomain.description: Override the domain with this value. This will change the domain returned in your uploads. Leave blank to use the default domain.

addOriginalName.label: Add Original Name
addOriginalName.description: Add the original file name, so that the file can be downloaded with the original name. This will still use the "Name Format" option for it's file name.

extensionless.label: Extensionless URL
extensionless.description: Remove the file extension from the returned URL. The file can still be accessed with its extension. This option will only work if the server is configured to allow extensionless URLs.

xshareCompatibility.label: Xshare Compatibility
xshareCompatibility.description: If you choose to use the Xshare app on Android, enable this option for compatibility. The generated config will not work with ShareX.

waylandCompatibility.label: Enable Wayland Compatibility
waylandCompatibility.description: Use wl-copy instead of xclip for copying to clipboard.

macCompatibility.label: Enable macOS Compatibility
macCompatibility.description: Use pbcopy instead of xclip for copying to clipboard.

compositorUnsupported.label: Using a DE other than Gnome, KDE or Sway?
compositorUnsupported.description: If using a compositor such as Hyprland, this option will set the XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=sway to workaround Flameshot's errors on Wayland. This is not needed on Xorg.

useEcho.label: Use echo instead of copying to clipboard
useEcho.description: Just output the url to the terminal instead of copying it to the clipboard.

modal.waylandHelp: If you are having trouble getting Flameshot to work on Wayland, consult the <link>Wayland guide</link>.
